import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

def parse(series):
    dates = [datetime.strptime(d['date'], '%Y-%m') for d in series]
    vals = [d['value'] for d in series]
    return dates, vals

dates, cpi = parse(data['cpi_inflation']['data'])
_, wages = parse(data['wage_growth']['data'])
_, ffr = parse(data['federal_funds_rate']['data'])
_, real_w = parse(data['real_wage_growth']['data'])

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 7.5))

# Colors - editorial palette
c_cpi = '#D32F2F'
c_wage = '#1565C0'
c_ffr = '#2E7D32'
c_real = '#6A1B9A'

# Real wage squeeze shading (negative real wage)
real_arr = np.array(real_w)
dates_arr = np.array(dates)
neg_mask = real_arr < 0
# Find contiguous negative regions
in_neg = False
for i in range(len(real_arr)):
    if real_arr[i] < 0 and not in_neg:
        start = i
        in_neg = True
    elif (real_arr[i] >= 0 or i == len(real_arr)-1) and in_neg:
        end = i if real_arr[i] >= 0 else i+1
        ax.axvspan(dates_arr[max(0,start-1)], dates_arr[min(len(dates_arr)-1, end)],
                   alpha=0.08, color=c_real, zorder=0)
        in_neg = False

# Peak inflation zone highlight (May-Jul 2022)
peak_start = datetime(2022, 5, 1)
peak_end = datetime(2022, 8, 1)
ax.axvspan(peak_start, peak_end, alpha=0.12, color=c_cpi, zorder=0)
ax.annotate('Peak Inflation\nZone', xy=(datetime(2022, 6, 15), 9.3),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=c_cpi, ha='center', va='bottom',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec=c_cpi, alpha=0.85))

# Rate hike lag annotation
hike_start = datetime(2022, 3, 1)
cpi_peak = datetime(2022, 6, 1)
ax.annotate('', xy=(cpi_peak, 9.5), xytext=(hike_start, 9.5),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#444', lw=1.5))
ax.text(datetime(2022, 4, 15), 9.75, 'Rate hike → inflation\npeak lag (~3 mo.)',
        fontsize=8.5, ha='center', color='#444', style='italic')

# Plot lines
ax.plot(dates, cpi, color=c_cpi, lw=2.5, label='CPI Inflation (YoY)', zorder=3)
ax.plot(dates, wages, color=c_wage, lw=2.2, label='Wage Growth (YoY)', zorder=3)
ax.plot(dates, ffr, color=c_ffr, lw=2.5, ls='--', label='Federal Funds Rate',
        drawstyle='steps-post', zorder=4)
ax.plot(dates, real_w, color=c_real, lw=1.8, label='Real Wage Growth (YoY)', zorder=3)

# Zero line for real wages
ax.axhline(0, color='#888', lw=0.7, ls=':', zorder=1)

# Real wage squeeze label
ax.annotate('Real Wage Squeeze\n(CPI > Wage Growth)',
            xy=(datetime(2022, 1, 1), -2.5), fontsize=8.5, color=c_real,
            fontweight='bold', ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec=c_real, alpha=0.85))

# Real wage recovery label
ax.annotate('Real wages\nturn positive',
            xy=(datetime(2023, 5, 1), 0.4), xytext=(datetime(2023, 8, 1), -1.5),
            fontsize=8, color=c_real, ha='center',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_real, lw=1.2))

# Fed rate annotation
ax.annotate('Fed rate reaches\n5.33%', xy=(datetime(2023, 7, 1), 5.33),
            xytext=(datetime(2023, 10, 1), 6.5), fontsize=8, color=c_ffr,
            fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_ffr, lw=1.2),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white', ec=c_ffr, alpha=0.85))

# First rate hike marker
ax.plot(datetime(2022, 3, 1), 0.33, 'o', color=c_ffr, markersize=7, zorder=5)
ax.annotate('First rate hike\nMar 2022', xy=(datetime(2022, 3, 1), 0.33),
            xytext=(datetime(2021, 10, 1), 2.5), fontsize=8, color=c_ffr,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c_ffr, lw=1.2))

ax.set_title('The U.S. Inflation Spiral: CPI, Wages, Fed Policy & Real Wages (2021–2024)',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Rate / Growth (%)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlabel('')
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(bymonth=[1,7]))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%b\n%Y'))
ax.set_xlim(datetime(2020, 12, 15), datetime(2025, 1, 15))
ax.set_ylim(-5, 11)
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(2))
ax.yaxis.set_minor_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(1))
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, lw=0.5)

ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=10, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#ccc')

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print('Done')
